correctness.rationale: The exact rate is lambda_min(C^(1/2)diag(pi)C^(1/2)). Its concavity gives unrestricted block averaging. The explicit invariant-subspace decomposition gives two contrast rates and a strictly concave 2×2 mean-mode rate. A determinant tangent identity identifies its global peak; two linear-versus-concave crossing identities establish the four exhaustive branches, thresholds and positive denominators. An exact PSD decomposition proves unbounded gain. A standalone replay gives 13,070 exact attainment tests and 91,843 sampled non-improvement tests. Finite verification is auxiliary to the symbolic proof.

value.rationale: Positive two-community exchangeable Hessians are a motivated correlated optimization model. The result replaces a general semidefinite program with a full closed-form structural classification on an infinite family, including four independently witnessed spectral regimes, the exact c²=ab boundary, and an unbounded uniform-sampling performance gap in the sharp one-step metric. This is more than a renamed general SDP or an isolated parameter evaluation.
